records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Zara,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Next step on your Wrenfield setup
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Following up on our kickoff last week — I know the first week gets busy, so no worries if Wrenfield has been on the back burner.

Whenever you're ready, the usual first step is creating a project: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through that first project with you and answer anything that came up since kickoff.

Best,
Nadia
